acceptanceStatus: Hardware gates complete: plain overview GPU savings demonstrated; final counterbalanced edit results show no consistent regression within observed run variance. Final repository verification is owned by the parent agent.
finalCandidateScope: Fit ABBA, first edit pair, memory and actual-frame quality used overview-final. Reverse churn/flip and final boundary/zoom used overview-hysteresis (only10%activation margin inside the certified band). Final editable ABBA uses overview-editfix, which also separates canonical address gathering, skips unchanged span prefixes, hoists source lookup and stores offsets only at command/span boundaries. No geometry or shader change among these three candidates.
limitations: Default ETL10k had zero certified overview starts: no ETL geometry/GPU reduction is claimed.
Structural add/delete and group editing still have significant preexisting CPU cost; source-local uploads do not imply frame-budget parity.
Fit rAF can straddle refresh thresholds; GPU improvement is not a promised frame-rate multiplier.
The historical pre-loop-fix certificate edits cost3–5ms more CPU. Final loop-fix ABBA no longer shows a consistent premium; variable compact suffix uploads remain possible.
Only plain/inactive eligible effects are reduced; active dash phase and custom effects retain canonical geometry.
